name: v3_low_systematic_risk_quality
hypothesis: Quality signals may work better when tilted away from high market-driven risk; low systematic risk plus operating profitability should be less correlated with pure analyst yield.
notes: Combines quality with model risk metric; intended to diversify from EBITDA/EV.

name: v3_buyback_yield_quality
hypothesis: Share repurchase payments relative to market cap can proxy shareholder yield; combine with quality to avoid distressed buybacks.
notes: Low-crowding buyback field plus quality anchor; sparse field risk controlled by truncation.

name: v3_rd_efficiency_quality
hypothesis: R&D intensity is useful when paired with operating profitability; raw R&D expense alone may be sector exposure.
expression: 0.5 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry) - 0.5 * group_rank(ts_rank(rd_expense / sales, 126), subindustry)
notes: Tests investment efficiency rather than analyst yield; sign penalizes high R&D burden unless quality offsets it.

name: v3_news_earnings_sentiment_quality
hypothesis: Average earnings-evaluation news sentiment may add event information when combined with slow operating quality.
notes: Uses matrix Ravenpack aggregate instead of vector news fields.

name: v3_range_reversal_quality
hypothesis: High recent range can indicate noisy overreaction; pairing range reversal with quality may lower turnover and avoid pure technical crowding.
expression: 0.5 * rank(-ts_zscore((high - low) / close, 20)) + 0.5 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: QuantaAlpha-inspired range reversal crossed with a quality anchor, but not EBITDA/EV.
